quote: Restricted cash as of June 30, 2026, consisted of (i) funds held in the debt service reserve account established under the indenture governing the Company’s $3.3 billion aggregate principal amount of 7.75% Senior Secured Notes due 2031 (the “Senior Secured Notes”), (ii) funds held in escrow in connection with the pending acquisition of Polaris DS LLC, which will be applied to the purchase price at closing, and (iii) funds held in escrow in connection with certain construction and development activities.
